# cfg (in reconcile-owed/): # A renamed person's revoke whose read of the ids failed (ReconcileOwed.tla; remote/core_revokes.rs owe_cut, pay_owed, clear_owed). Whole-config rows.

why: the failed read leaves an owed row, the poll pays it under every id, an undo clears it: TypeOK, NoLostUndo, FailCutHoldsOwed, Narrows, FailCutReached
FailCutReached: no owed row, the old id is never cut (revoke fails, rename, cut with the read falling back, stutter)
NoLostUndo: the undo leaves the row, and the retry cuts a person the owner gave back
